note: Each correction is one step on one setting. Claude applies the step, re-renders and re-runs the judge.

corrections.description: Make the eye corners rounder and the outline a smoother oval (less pointed corners).
corrections.setting: build_head.py almond(): upper exponent a**2.2 -> a**1.9, lower (1-a^2)**0.60 -> **0.50

corrections.description: Make the eye corners more pointed.
corrections.setting: build_head.py almond(): upper exponent a**2.2 -> a**2.6

corrections.description: Make the eye opening taller relative to its width.
Make the eye opening shorter (narrower slit) relative to its width.
Move the eyes further apart (wider gap between them).
Move the eyes closer together.
Make the iris larger inside the eye.
Make the iris smaller inside the eye.
Make the iris colour lighter and the light lower area bigger.
corrections.setting: apply_look.py mhs3_eye_material iris x1.2, low ellipse radii x1.15

corrections.description: Make the iris colour darker and the light lower area smaller.
corrections.setting: apply_look.py mhs3_eye_material iris x0.8, low ellipse radii x0.87

corrections.description: Make the dark concentric arcs inside the iris thicker and more visible.
Make the pupil larger.
Make the pupil smaller.
Remove the small second highlight so only the one big highlight remains.
Make the main white highlight bigger.
Make the white of the eye greyer and less blue/lavender.
Make the upper lid line an even medium thickness with only a slightly thicker outer end, no long pointed wedge past the corner.
corrections.setting: apply_look.py upper lid th: outer term 0.006*t^2 -> 0.003*t^2, wrap start 0.018 -> 0.012

corrections.description: Make the upper lid line thicker overall.
Make the lower lid line run the full length of the lower lid, darker, joining the upper line at the outer corner.
corrections.setting: apply_look.py lower lid seg from wrap end to 0.95 of the lid, colour x0.75, th 0.0045 -> 0.0055

corrections.description: Make the brows thicker.
Make the brows thinner.
Move the brows down, closer to the eyes.
Move the brows up, further from the eyes.
Give the brows a gentle arch instead of a straight line.
Make the brow colour darker brown.
